sections.name: Don Bongo
sections.card:
Summary: The boss at the end of the level Frustration. He paces across his room, and pots and pans fall from the ceiling while he does.
Weak points: Three egg hits on his lips beat him. An egg that lands on the rest of his body bounces away.
Looks like: A plump, dragon-like creature with green skin, yellow spots, thick red lips and a striped yellow belly.
Tips: Walking into him costs no health, because you just bounce off. Only the things falling from the ceiling can hurt you.
Tips: Each hit makes his lips swell, which gives you a slightly easier target, but once they have been hit twice he moves much faster.

sections.name: Cloudjin
sections.card:
Summary: A genie made of smoke that you face once the level Poochy & Nippy has its 30 fruits eaten. He sends spiked balls rolling down slippery see-saws and breathes fire.
Weak points: Aim for his stomach with three eggs, and only while his body is solid.
Looks like: A giant genie made of smoke that floats about.
Tips: Only the Japanese release makes him flash red when an egg hurts him, so in other releases that flash is not a sign to look for.

sections.name: Inviso
sections.card:
Summary: A ghost boss at the end of The Tall Tower. He goes invisible and tries to bump into Yoshi while he calls in Peepers.
Weak points: It takes three egg hits to beat him.
Looks like: He is invisible, and the only sign of him is the surroundings reflected on his body.
Tips: An egg that strips a Peeper of its feathers makes it fall, and eating it at that point heals Yoshi fully.

sections.name: Cloud N. Candy
sections.card:
Summary: A vast, smiling cloud made of yellow cotton candy, fought at the end of the level Cloud Cruising.
Weak points: You lick her to beat her. Each lick takes a piece off, and she is beaten once she has been eaten up.
Looks like: A very large floating cloud with a smile on it, yellow and fluffy like cotton candy.
Tips: She leaps around and hurts you if you touch her, and the smaller she gets the faster and nimbler she is. Every lick gives some of your health back.

sections.name: Bone Dragon
sections.card:
Summary: Skeleton dragons with more than one head that stand in your way in the level Bone Dragon Pit and now and then spit a fireball.
Weak points: Hit a head twice with eggs, or ground-pound it twice. On the three-headed kind, every head needs its own two hits.
Looks like: A big dragon skeleton with more than one head, like a hydra. The three-headed kind has a body as well.
Tips: Touching the body of a three-headed one does not hurt you. Beating a Bone Dragon earns three melons.

sections.name: Snorkel Snake
sections.card:
Summary: A serpentine enemy in one area of the level Lots O'Jelly Fish, which swims in circles around a Yoshi that comes near. The game treats it as a mini-boss, yet it cannot be beaten.
Looks like: A large white creature with green spikes and a big fin as a tail, with a ball-shaped head that has red eyes and flippers and a long spout for a mouth.
Tips: You cannot throw eggs underwater, so it is practically invincible. Instead of beating it, you are meant to defeat the Cheep Cheeps in its lair while you keep clear of it.
Tips: Its body is too short to close a full circle, so a Yoshi it has ringed can still swim out.

sections.name: Heart Fruit and Super Happy
sections.card:
Summary: A fruit that makes the Yoshi who eats it Super Happy for a short while. It turns up in bubbles, or floats down after you eat six of the same fruit in a row.
Uses: A Super Happy Yoshi is invincible and stronger, has endless eggs, a longer tongue and extra flutter-jumping, and gets the whole Smile Meter back. A ground pound pops every bubble on screen, turns Shy Guys into Lucky Fruits and peppers into coins.
Tips: The effect ends early if you eat a blue Tehee Butterfly, a Black Shy Guy or a pepper, if a Piranha Pest swallows you, or when you move on to an area that turns the page.
Tips: Being Super Happy does not save you from fatal hazards such as Blurps, pits, lava or pistons.

sections.name: Special Hearts
sections.card:
Summary: Three hearts hidden in every level. Each one you collect opens a new level on the next page.
Uses: After the first page, only the first level of the next page is open unless you collected a Special Heart in the level you just played. You need all three to open every level on that page. Each one also heals the Yoshi fully.
Tips: Chimes ring when a Baby Yoshi is close to one, and an egg can be thrown to collect one.
Tips: Each Special Heart is worth 100 hearts toward Yoshi's Mood at the end of the level.

sections.name: Power Flower
sections.card:
Summary: A special sunflower growing from the ground. A Baby Yoshi that eats its head is healed.
Uses: Eating the head gives back two petals of the Smile Meter. It earns no points, so it does nothing for Yoshi's Mood at the end of the level.
Looks like: A sunflower on a green stem with green leaves. The head is yellow with red petals, black eyes and a small red mouth.
Tips: The head grows back quickly after it is eaten, so you can keep eating until the Smile Meter is full.

sections.name: Bomb Berry
sections.card:
Summary: A spiked fruit that grows only in the level Jungle Puddle. It tastes horrible to most Yoshis.
Uses: It is a hazard, not a meal. Touching one makes the Smile Meter lose petals. Eating one does too, except for the Black and White Yoshis.
Looks like: A yellow and red eggplant-shaped fruit covered in green spikes.
Tips: A Bomb Berry is invisible at first and swells to full size once you walk past. When it gets heavy enough it drops into the water and sinks, and after a while a new one grows in the same spot.

sections.name: Pak E. Derm
sections.card:
Summary: An elephant-like creature that stands in your way holding a stop sign. You meet three of them, all in the level Treasure Hunt.
Tips: A ground pound makes it fall on its head, and you can slip past. Be quick, because it soon flips back upright.
Tips: It stands in the middle of the path you are taking, and if you switch to the other path it moves over to block that one too.

sections.name: Tehee Butterfly
sections.card:
Summary: A flying butterfly that keeps changing colour between pink and blue. What happens when you eat it depends on its colour at that moment.
Looks like: A round flying insect that changes colour from pink to blue.
Tips: Eat a pink one to get health back. A blue one is bitter and takes health away. If you eat a blue one while Super Happy, that form ends early.
Tips: You can also jump on one as a springboard, which is when the wiki calls it a Tehee Trampoline.

sections.name: Black Shy Guy (Yoshi's Story)
sections.card:
Summary: An aggressive kind of Flying Shy Guy, first met in the level Poochy & Nippy.
Tips: In Poochy & Nippy they swoop down from above the screen and drop bombs on you, and those bombs can break rock blocks for you. On Page 6 they hover holding weights that fall automatically if you ground-pound near one.
Tips: A ground pound near one does not affect it. Eating one gives a black-spotted egg, but most Yoshis lose three petals of the Smile Meter and Super Happy ends, while the Black and White Yoshis seem to tolerate it and gain two petals.

sections.name: Air Bag
sections.card:
Summary: A giant pink balloon that hides inside a Mystery Crate in the second half of Surprise!!, a first-page level.
Weak points: Hit the two bandages on its belly with an egg or one of Huffin Puffin's chicks, twice. It then deflates until it disappears and leaves a melon.
Looks like: A big pink balloon with a pair of bandages on its belly.
Tips: Its crate cannot be pushed or broken by a ground pound. Shoot an egg or a chick at the crate to make the Air Bag show itself.
Tips: Its attack is a strong gust of air that does no damage, but it can push you into other enemies.

sections.name: Blindfold Boo
sections.card:
Summary: A blindfolded Boo found only in the Ghost Castle, with four of them there: three at the start and one in the tower climb. It finds you by sound.
Looks like: In this game a Boo with a light-blue blindfold and false pink ears in place of arms.
Tips: It is invulnerable to attacks, and once it is chasing you it moves faster than a Yoshi can run. A touch or any attack from it costs three petals of the Smile Meter.
